scope: Widget completion error recovery in independently owned Mac and iOS local workspaces; native Mac filesystem failure and native iPhone queued recurring completion.
defects: Widget consumption reset its internal status but left the matching notice intact; local sync then returned before cloud cleanup could clear the stale banner.
The Mac grammar debug bundle was absent from the private widget-storage allowlist, producing an App Group storage error in an app-only test variant.
The catch message claimed a completion was waiting even when only checking an empty queue had failed; the local Mac status row also exposed a cloud-upload icon.
changes: Each Store clears only a notice equal to its previous widget action status before retrying. Other notices are preserved by the equality guard; a new failure sets a fresh warning.
Both apps report Widget actions need attention for this error boundary.
Mac local status uses a generic warning icon; the decorative image is hidden from accessibility.
The exact grammar test bundle joins the existing DEBUG private storage allowlist; normal/Release App Group behavior is unchanged.
Each repository owns its own DEBUG queue/consume/recovery controls and native regression.

macNative.beforeFix: Old binary with private storage: startup under a reversible 0400 lock-file fault showed a warning; restoring original 0600 and invoking Retry left it visible.
macNative.afterFix: The rebuilt app without the widget overlay correctly reported the same real lock-file failure. Restoring 0600 and invoking native sidebar Retry removed the banner and Retry link immediately. Normal Quit/relaunch remained clear.
macNative.limit: No new Mac XCTest runtime result; native CUA supplies the lock-failure/retry acceptance.

recovery.behavior: Queue a genuine recurring completion, fail durable save through the existing DEBUG fixture, acknowledge the actual save-error alert, then retry through Store.sync without relaunch. Warning clears; one completed original, one successor, empty queue and durable receipt survive relaunch.

builds.macWarning: AppIntents metadata extraction skipped in app-only variant; no AppIntents.framework dependency.

limits: Native Mac test exercised reading an empty queue under a real filesystem fault; the new queued recurring-save recovery regression executed on iPhone only.
No new installed-widget, physical device, VoiceOver or distribution acceptance is inferred.
Preservation of an unrelated notice is enforced by the source equality guard; it was not separately fault-injected in this native walk.
The existing authenticated Mac variant still awaits its Keychain prompt; grammar runtime does not clear that separate cloud gate.
No Todoist operations or cloud task edits were performed. Existing cloud and Focus Mac processes were left intact.
